spread_description: The flow of a situation across time: past, present and future.

cards.position_meaning: Roots and events already shaping the situation.
cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.meaning: The Hierophant transmits established wisdom and tradition, pointing to teachers, institutions and shared belief.

cards.position_meaning: The current dynamics and where you stand now.
cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.meaning: A merchant pours coins to kneeling beggars, weighing generosity and the balance of give and take.

cards.position_meaning: The likely direction if things continue as they are.
cards.name: King of Wands
cards.meaning: Reversed, leadership curdles into tyranny or impulsive overreach driven by unrealistic expectations.

synthesis: Reading the Three Card (时间之流三张). Past (过去) draws The Hierophant (教皇) upright, highlighting spiritual wisdom, tradition, conformity. Present (现在) draws Six of Pentacles (星币六) upright, highlighting giving, receiving, sharing wealth. Future (未来) draws King of Wands (权杖国王) reversed, highlighting impulsiveness, haste, ruthless. 1 Major Arcana card(s) mark the significant, fated threads running through an otherwise everyday situation. 1 reversed card(s) point to energies that are blocked, internalised or delayed, and ask to be examined rather than forced.
